MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

2. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 4
   C. 3
   D. 5

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

5. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

9. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 29
   C. 28
   D. 11

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 22
   C. 14
   D. 33

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 37
   D. 13

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

14. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 0

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

18. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

19. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

20. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 49

21. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 13

22. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 10

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 18
   C. 45
   D. 36

24. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

25. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

26. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 1

27. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

28. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 65

29. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

30. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15
